normalization.method: Subtract participant median signed FPPA reference before computing bottom/peak/asymmetry
normalization.reference: Per-rep most upright 20% of frames by hip midpoint y; median of rep references per participant
normalization.limitation: Upright proxy is not verified standing; uses unlabeled frames from all held-out participant reps (test-time calibration). Not an uncalibrated deployment estimate.
